page.overview:
Who is Tifa Lockhart?

20 years old (Final Fantasy VII/Remake)TBA (Street Fighter 6)

Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, Final Fantasy VII Revelation) Ayaka Mitsumoto (Final Fantasy VII Remake, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth) (Young) Yōko Asada (Ehrgeiz: God Bless the Ring) (Arcade) Yūko Minaguchi (Ehrgeiz: God Bless the Ring) (PS)

Britt Baron (Final Fantasy VII Remake, Crisis Core -Final Fantasy VII- Reunion, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, Final Fantasy VII Revelation) Glory Curda (Final Fantasy VII Remake, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth) (Young)

During the early drafts of Final Fantasy VII, Tifa was originally a background character, with her role in Avalanche being to support everyone behind the scenes and cheer them up after missions. In the earliest days of development, there was an iteration of Tifa who was going to be related to Sephiroth. In the final stages, attention went into developing Tifa and her relationships with the other characters, resulting the idea of Final Fantasy VII having two heroines, the other being Aerith.
